checks.name: Quit in the moment the last key is pressed: the pending words are sent before the library stops and are on the note once after the restart
Quit at once with the database dead: the words are kept as a retained draft at quit, the reopened note names them, and putting them back leaves every sentence in the note once
quitLog: [quit] 1 note not saved at quit: 1 kept as retained drafts

limits: One machine, one run, one note. The quit is the app's own quit, asked for in the same moment the last key is pressed; a kill of the process while a save is in flight is not produced here (a killed host is covered by the reclaim rehearsal, where unsaved keystrokes of the last moments are lost).
